desc: Derive that the operation reverses three consecutive gaps, equivalently swaps gaps two positions apart, so gaps preserve 1-based index parity and all permutations within each parity class are reachable.
Derive objective formula: sum = N*X_1 + sum_{j=1}^{N-1} (N-j)*gap_j, with X_1 invariant.
Implement full Python solution with integer arithmetic and correct 0-based parity/weight mapping.
Validate on sample inputs and edge cases (N=4, equal gaps, large coordinates); if any fail, adjust parity/weight mapping or approach.
